tagline: Make Loom videos a first-class part of your Slack workflow with automatic summaries and routing
metaTitle: Slack + Loom Integration: Loom Links Summarized in Slack
metaDescription: Summarize Loom links shared in Slack, route new recordings to the channels, and pull action items from videos. GAIA does the watching. See the setup steps.
intro:
Loom recordings are a powerful async communication tool, but they create a new coordination problem: who has seen the video, which channel should it go in, and what were the key takeaways for people who don't have time to watch? When recordings are shared ad-hoc in Slack, they often sit unviewed or their content never gets discussed because extracting context from a video mid-thread requires too much friction.

GAIA makes these videos a productive part of your workflow by handling the translation between the two. When a Loom is shared in a channel, GAIA generates a text summary and adds it as a reply so everyone gets the key points without watching the whole video. When a new recording is created in your workspace, GAIA routes it to the appropriate channel based on the content or creator. Team members can respond to a video's content directly in the thread, and GAIA keeps the conversation organized.

For async-first teams where video is a primary communication format, this integration means video content is no longer a black box in Slack—it's a structured, searchable, actionable part of the team's communication flow.

useCases.title: Auto-summarize Loom links shared in Slack
useCases.description: When a team member shares a link to a recording in any channel, GAIA generates a concise text summary of the video content and replies in the thread so everyone can get the key points without watching the full recording.

useCases.title: Route new Loom recordings to the right channels
useCases.description: When a recording is created in your workspace, GAIA analyzes the title, description, and content to route it to the most relevant channel automatically: product updates to #product, customer feedback recordings to #customer-success.

useCases.title: Extract action items from recordings
useCases.description: GAIA processes transcripts to identify action items, decisions, and commitments mentioned in the recording, and posts them as a structured list in the thread so nothing is lost in the video.

useCases.title: Notify Slack when recordings are viewed
useCases.description: When a shared recording is viewed by all intended recipients, GAIA can post a notification confirming everyone has seen the video, helping async teams confirm information has been received.

useCases.title: Weekly digest of recordings for team channels
useCases.description: GAIA compiles a weekly digest of recordings created by and for your team, posts it to the relevant channel with summaries of each video, and ensures no recorded update gets missed.

howItWorks.step: Connect Slack and Loom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Slack workspace and Loom account in GAIA's settings. GAIA monitors the recording workspace and the channels you designate for automatic processing.
Tell GAIA how to handle new recordings: which channels to route them to, whether to auto-summarize, and what to extract from transcripts. Define rules in plain language based on your team's workflow.

howItWorks.step: Video content becomes active in the channel automatically
howItWorks.description: As recordings are created and shared, GAIA processes them, routes them to the right channels, and surfaces their content in text form so video communication becomes a searchable part of your channel history.

faqs.question: Does GAIA summarize all Loom links or only from specific workspaces?
faqs.answer: You configure the scope. GAIA can summarize all links shared in monitored channels, only recordings from your organization's workspace, or only videos matching specific criteria like title keywords or creator.

faqs.question: What plan is needed for GAIA to access transcripts?
faqs.answer: Auto-transcription is available on Business plans and above. For Starter plan recordings without transcripts, GAIA summarizes based on the video title, description, and any captions included by the creator.

faqs.question: Can GAIA prompt team members to record a video from within Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA in a channel to suggest a recording for a specific topic or to a specific person. GAIA will generate a suggested recording prompt and can send a DM to the relevant person encouraging them to record.

faqs.question: Does this work with recordings shared from outside my organization?
faqs.answer: GAIA can summarize public links shared in channels regardless of whether they're from your organization, as long as the recordings are publicly accessible. For private recordings, access depends on the sharing settings of the video.
